conditions.condition_text: Wait for price to break into the VWAP value area and then test the VWAP line.
The VWAP acts as a magnet during a trending day.
Enter on strength in the direction away from the VWAP after the first test.
The test of VWAP confirms the trend and provides a high-probability entry.
The strategy is only effective when the market is in a trending day or high volatility.
The stop goes above or below the testing candle at the VWAP.
